LYGO Second Brain 1.0.0 – Initial Release

- Provides a LYGO-native local "second brain" using an Obsidian markdown vault and Ollama for LLM inference.
- Enables raw note ingestion, embedding and indexing, vault-only semantic search, multi-model consensus, and wiki page generation.
- Integrates git-based memory and optional stack manifest for tracking.
- Focused on secure, local knowledge compounding—cloud fallback and automation are limited by default.
- Simple command-line interface for ingest, index, search, consensus, and wiki operations.
